description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility. Its purpose is to direct log messages to Android's logging system and propagate logs to the next node in a chain if present, facilitating flexible logging targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to enable chaining of log nodes and outputting logs to Android's log system.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then forwards the log to the next node if available.
